subject.title: fix(gateway): cancel run-bound approvals on abort and expose approval-park lifecycle

question: Should this gateway/protocol lifecycle change land after a maintainer confirms the three optional approval identity fields are acceptable across supported gateway clients and reviews live abort behavior evidence?
rationale: The patch changes the approval authorization lifecycle and gateway protocol surface; green unit coverage cannot by itself settle cross-client compatibility or prove the user-visible abort path.

options.title: Confirm protocol and request proof
options.body: Keep the additive fields and merge only after a maintainer confirms the client contract and the PR includes redacted after-fix runtime evidence.

options.title: Narrow to server-side cancellation
options.body: Remove or defer client lifecycle/protocol exposure if maintainers want the abort safety fix without expanding the gateway event contract.
